repos_data.description: Governed memory for long-lived coding agents. Trust, provenance, conflict detection. Local-first.
Universal memory layer for AI applications. Self-host in minutes. Open source.
Your AI forgets everything between sessions. SAME fixes that. Local-first, no API keys, single binary.
Local-first memory engine for AI-agent teams — private/team/project ACL, associative recall, federated sync, and a built-in MCP server. One SQLite file, no LLM required. Apache-2.0.
Shared memory layer for AI coding tools. One local SQLite DB, every tool reads the same verified facts. Local-first, zero cloud.
Zero context compaction for Claude Code & LLM agents. Persistent memory powered by OS primitives (demand paging, kswapd eviction, mlock pinning). Single SQLite file, MCP-native, multi-agent shared.
Persistent memory for AI agents — local, portable, zero config. Works with Cursor, Windsurf, Claude via MCP.
Durable, local-first memory for AI coding agents over MCP — zero-dependency, curated & semantically de-duped, you own the data (SQLite + Markdown). Works with Claude Code, Codex & any MCP host.
Durable hybrid memory for AI agents: vector + BM25 + temporal + graph recall, exposed through MCP, HTTP, and Python.
Persistent memory for AI agents. Agents forget. CI remembers.
Lossless local memory for Claude Code. The full, unabbreviated version. Every tool call, every file edit, every thinking block — stored verbatim on your machine. Persistent memory without tokens.
One memory, every terminal — a shared memory layer for any MCP client.

repo_meta_data.description: Local-first, eval-first memory for long-horizon AI agents — no LLM at ingest. Python SDK + MCP server with source-traceable recall, belief revision, selective forgetting, and reproducible benchmarks.
